description: This file provides utility functions and classes for authentication and tenant management in a FastAPI application, including header-based tenant context resolution and connector authentication enforcement.

classes.name: TenantContext
classes.description: A class representing the tenant context resolved from request headers.

methods.name: TenantContext get_tenant_context(x_tenant_id: Optional[str] = Header(default=None))
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves and returns the tenant context based on 'X-Tenant-ID' header, raising an error if missing.

methods.name: require_authenticated_connector( x_user_id: Optional[str] = Header(default=None), x_connector_key: Optional[str] = Header(default=None), ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )
methods.description: Asynchronously ensures that a user token exists for the given connector, based on headers and tenant context.

ctags.name: require_authenticated_connector
ctags.signature: ( x_user_id: Optional[str] = Header(default=None), x_connector_key: Optional[str] = Header(default=None), ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )
